text:
deploy-bot: Starting staged rollout: v2.3.1-rc5 -> 5% traffic in eu-west (change window 23:00-02:00 UTC). Monitor: p95 latency +12% vs baseline, error rate +0.8% (relative). Rolling policy: canary. /status for details
ashley: seeing the p95 bump on traces, tail effect around 1.2s extra for long requests. Not huge but visible.
diego: checking infra logs now — noticing a spike of kvcache misses on a subset of nodes right after traffic shifted. dumping sample spans.
nina: could be cold-kv on the new kernel path. If warmup doesn't stabilize in 10m, recommend soft-pin eu-west back to v2.3.1-rc4 and continue investigating.
sam: agree with nina. We should avoid a full rollback if it's just caching warmup. Can we pin traffic in-region while leaving global rollout?
deploy-bot: Ack. To pin: run `/deploy pin v2.3.1-rc4 --region eu-west --duration 30m --note "soft-pin due to kv warmup"`. Would you like me to execute?
ashley: please run the pin. Also start a short smoke test against edge nodes after pin to confirm latency returns to baseline.
sam: adding quick QA checklist: 1) p95 back to within 3% of baseline 2) 5xx <= 0.3% 3) kv cache hit ratio improves. Tag me when done.
deploy-bot: Executing pin... 
```
# deploy-bot log
cmd: /deploy pin v2.3.1-rc4 --region eu-west --duration 30m --note "soft-pin due to kv warmup"
status: accepted
action: traffic re-routed to v2.3.1-rc4 for eu-west
eta: ~30s
```
ashley: confirmed — traffic now on rc4 in eu-west. p95 trending down to +2% within 5 minutes. kv hit ratio recovered from 68% -> 91% on sampled hosts.
diego: logs look cleaner. The new kernel path had a subtle lock contention causing cold-cache penalties; will open a hotfix PR to adjust backoff.
nina: remote-run smoke tests passing (basic convo tests). No spike in 5xx. I'm comfortable leaving the soft-pin for the 30m window and then resuming canary if heat remains stable.
sam: :thumbsup: thanks. Let's capture this in the release notes and ops timeline. Release notes link: https://release-notes.redwood.dev/v2.3.1-rc5
sre-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-0421 — canary latency tail observed; soft-pin applied to eu-west. Assigned: diego. Severity: low.
deploy-bot: Soft-pin will auto-expire at 30m unless extended. To extend: `/deploy pin extend 30m --region eu-west`. To unpin early: `/deploy unpin --region eu-west`.
ashley: I'll re-check metrics at +15m and +25m. If stable we can let pin expire and continue the staged rollout to 20% tomorrow morning's warm window.
diego: PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/commit/ab12cd — fix lock backoff. Will push canary patch after rc5 stabilizes.
nina: leaving a note for oncall: watch p95 and kv hit ratio for eu-west for the next hour.
sam: adding a short blurb to the release checklist: "soft-pin applied during canary due to kv warmup; rc5 resumed pending warmup fix."
ashley: thanks everyone. Closing this thread once the pin auto-expires or someone confirms resume.
sre-bot: Reminder scheduled in 20m: check eu-west canary health."
